race.title: Midnite Building The Future Of Betting Handicap
race.verdict: Ollie Sangster 3-y-o RIDGER makes obvious appeal under Billy Loughnane. Crown The Future is in a good vein of form and will be a threat if Charlie Tucker can get him into a good position from stall 12. Teggy Lasso would also need considering if the betting vibes are strong starting out for Mick Appleby and the Horse Watchers. RIDGER (IRE) CROWN THE FUTURE (IRE) TEGGY LASSO (IRE)
